content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in El Paso

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree (high school diploma or equivalent) and completion of formal project management education—but no prior work experience. This makes CAPM ideal for El Paso professionals across military, logistics, healthcare, and government sectors seeking entry into project management without a lengthy career prerequisite.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp format. Our intensive course covers the PMBOK® Guide framework and prepares you for exam content. You'll learn alongside peers, interact with active certified practitioners, and maintain the flexibility to study from anywhere in El Paso on your schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your CAPM application, confirming your education hours and eligibility. Pay the associated PMI exam fee during this step. Our team can guide you through the application portal to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor review sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. The exam tests your understanding of project management fundamentals, best practices, and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and continuous learning over a three-year renewal cycle. Staying active in project management communities and pursuing advanced certifications keeps your credential current and strengthens your career trajectory in El Paso's growing PM marketplace.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
